title: Perfect Family Sunset Sail
text: Truly magical. Did a private sail with our family- kids 4,7 and 10. Captain was very nice and spoke fluent English. They had kids life preservers and took safety seriously. Boat was clean and beautiful and we had a gorgeous swim. Thank you Hector!
author: monkeypod7

title: A sunset you won't forget
text:
We booked the boat tour at sunset and the experience was just perfect. Everything was great, very well organized and with a lovely atmosphere as we watched the sun go down and enjoyed the golden hour with Sitges in the background.

Special mention for Sandrine, who was lovely throughout, very loving, attentive and pending that we were all comfortable and enjoying. A highly recommended experience. To repeat.
author: martatm2401

title: Perfect time
text:
Very nice captain named Kai

Weather perfect

Full moon rise at the same time as sunset

Perfect length.   Two hours.   We really enjoyed it
author: Glenn S

title: A fantastic experience!
text: The staff was very warm, professional and supportive.   They communicated everything we needed to know in advance and did everything they could to make this a memorable experience!
author: James_B

title: Wonderful sunset cruise
text:
We had a great time on our sunset cruise yesterday, Toni was very friendly he played music for us, provided drinks and snacks and we could bring more of our drinks too. 
He let us drive the boat once we were out to sea too so got some great photos! 
Highly recommend
author: Nicola_F

title: Great day at sea in the Mediterranean (Sitges, Spain)
text: We had a fantastic day at sea!  The skipper was engaging and fun to hang out with.  He took plenty of pictures of us while we were in the water and on the boat. Would highly recommend to all!
author: Hugo R

title: Sunset sail
text: A lovely peaceful sailing trip to experience the sunset over sitges. Everything was perfect.  Oscar our skipper was the perfect host with cava, cheese and hams.  So glad we’ve booked this.
author: AnitaF717

title: Unforgettable afternoon
text:
We love it!!! I recommend it 100%. The treatment is unbeatable, the patterns are great and certainly make you feel like family. 
They have paddle surfing, a great activity if you go with children, friends or family.
author: nellamanente
